promotions.label: This week’s offers
promotions.boxTitle: One box of the week’s best fruit, every Sunday.
promotions.boxBody: About 5 kg for a family of four, chosen at Azadpur every Saturday night from whatever is at its peak that week.
promotions.greensTitle: Winter greens are in. Palak, gajar, methi, sarson.

overnight.title: While you sleep, the haat gets to work.
overnight.body: Nothing sits in a warehouse for days. What you order tonight is bought, graded and packed in the eight hours before you wake.

steps.title: Your order closes
steps.body: Change, add or skip anything until the cut-off.

steps.title: Picked at the mandi
steps.body: Our buyers choose at Azadpur and from farm partners, by hand.

steps.title: Graded and packed
steps.body: Sorted by size and ripeness, weighed, packed in paper.

steps.title: Into the cold van
steps.body: Dairy and greens ride at 4°C; fruit rides cool and shaded.

steps.title: At your door
steps.body: Before the first chai. No one rings the bell unless you ask.

items.quote: The Kinnaur apples taste like the ones my nani used to bring back from Shimla. I stopped going to the sabzi mandi on Sundays.
items.name: Ritika Malhotra

items.quote: Milk and palak arrive before my son’s school bus. Twice they replaced a soft pomegranate without me even sending a photo.
items.name: Arvind Iyer

items.quote: What I like is knowing where it comes from. Nagpur oranges in November, Nashik grapes in February. It feels like a real haat.
items.name: Farah Siddiqui

items.quote: Prices are honest. I compared the atta and dal for a month and stayed for the sourdough.
items.name: Harpreet Sandhu

items.title: Not right? Replaced, no questions.
items.body: Tell us by noon and we replace it tomorrow or refund it, whichever you prefer.

items.title: Priced by weight, shown before you pay.
items.body: Per kg and per piece, every day, with the MRP beside it.

items.title: Free delivery above {{free}}.
items.body: Below that, a flat {{fee}}. No surge, no rain fee, no packing charge.

items.title: Paper bags and returnable crates.
items.body: Leave yesterday’s crate outside and we take it back.

footer.letterBody: One short email each Friday: what is arriving at the haat, what is ending, and a recipe for it.
footer.emailError: That email doesn’t look right. Check for a missing @ or dot.
footer.emailDone: Subscribed. Your first letter arrives Friday morning.
footer.copyright: © {{year}} MeriHaat Fresh Pvt. Ltd. · Prices include GST.
footer.notRight: Not right? Tell us by noon for a free replacement the next morning.

palak.name: Desi Palak

red-carrot.name: Delhi Red Carrot

kheera.name: Desi Kheera
